steps.en: Company details are filled in automatically from MyInfo Business
steps.id: Detail company terisi otomatis dari MyInfo Business
steps.why_en: Only the company name is filled in; phone and email must be typed.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama company yang terisi; telepon dan email harus diketik sendiri.

steps.en: Company picks the ID type of the hirer or driver
steps.id: Company memilih jenis ID hirer atau driver

steps.en: Company enters the ID number and name of the hirer or driver
steps.id: Company mengisi nomor ID dan nama hirer atau driver

steps.en: Company enters the address, phone and email of the hirer or driver
steps.id: Company mengisi alamat, telepon dan email hirer atau driver

steps.en: Company states how the hirer or driver relates to the owner
steps.id: Company menyatakan hubungan hirer atau driver dengan owner

steps.en: Company attaches supporting documents such as PDF, jpg or png
steps.id: Company melampirkan dokumen pendukung seperti PDF, jpg atau png

steps.en: The hirer or driver details and documents are saved
steps.id: Detail hirer atau driver beserta dokumen disimpan
